blocks.text:
To: Elizabeth Horne
Cc: Jennifer Vasquez, David Sherman
The census file for the {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}} plan is usable, and the headcount ties to your summary. David Sherman reconciled it yesterday and it agrees line for line.

One field needs a definition before we rely on it. The file groups a set of participants under a status code we cannot read with confidence. Could you confirm how it distinguishes active participants from deferred vested ones? Once we have that, the census for the Howard and Sons plan is settled on our end, and nothing about the assumptions is locked before you have seen it.
